name: The Hegemon
gloss: Power is what moves the world. Windows open and close. Act while the window is open.

name: Shi (勢)
gloss: Power is what moves the world. Build your own position rather than force outcomes, and victory will happen naturally.

name: Grotian
gloss: Rules make cooperation long-lasting, but rules that are not properly enforced are not rules.

analogue.label: Hugo Grotius / De Jure Belli ac Pacis

name: Concert
gloss: Rules make cooperation long-lasting. Restraint and cooperation amongst the strong are what sustains them.

name: Iconoclast
gloss: The international system is held together by shared beliefs. To change the balance of power, one must change the story.

name: Nemawashi (根回し)
gloss: The international system is held together by shared beliefs. True legitimacy is built slowly through consensus, and cannot be demanded.

name: Dirigisme
gloss: Production, finance and trade structure politics. The state should guide and shape them.

name: Dependencia
gloss: Production, finance and dependence structure politics, and the first task is to reduce exposure.
